title: 🎥 Watch | Dr. Pezeshkian at the 8th Summit of Heads of State of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF):
text:
🎥 Watch | Dr. Pezeshkian at the 8th Summit of Heads of State of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF):"

"- Unilateral sanctions and US “economic terrorism” against Iran have seriously endangered the stability of energy markets."

"- Major global energy suppliers should condemn US military interventions in the Persian Gulf region and effectively confront them."

"- Global developments have made joint cooperation essential in developing “strategic governance and management” and “technical and engineering operations” for the energy market."

"- The Islamic Republic of Iran declares its readiness to play a more active role in developing joint investments, expanding gas trade, and strengthening global energy security.
